# Claude Code

Path: `vendor/claude-code`

This is vendored third-party tooling from Anthropic.

## Scope

The upstream README describes:

- terminal-first agentic coding workflows,
- IDE and GitHub integration,
- and a plugin ecosystem under `plugins/`.

## Current role in the tree

This directory is best understood as a vendored toolchain dependency, not as part of the authored product portfolio.
